info.name: Pandium Trigger a sync for a tenant

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the tenant.

items.docs: Request a sync for an existing tenant. Pandium debounces triggers to prevent more than one sync per tenant at any given time.

info.name: Pandium List runs for a tenant

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the tenant.

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

items.docs: Get runs for a specific tenant.

info.name: Pandium Get run status by trigger ID

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the tenant.

params.name: trigger_id
params.description: The trigger ID associated with a run.

items.docs: Returns status information for a run associated with the provided trigger ID, if that run exists. Since triggers are debounced, run status information may not be immediately available.
